name: emberward
title: Je-余烬灯塔

portmaster.desc: Original controller-first pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. The launcher uses an explicitly supplied Emberward PCK export.
portmaster.inst: Keep the SH and emberward folder together in Ports. Supply emberward/emberward.pck and install the listed PortMaster runtimes. Saves remain in emberward/conf.

notes: Launcher-only by default; EMBERWARD_PCK explicitly selects a game export for a complete local package. No saves, preview tools, mounted runtimes or device logs are collected.
